label: Hard
description: Hard cuff lining uses a heavier, firmly fused interlining that keeps the cuff stiff, flat, and razor-sharp throughout wear. It is the most formal option, ideal for evening and French cuffs where a rigid, structured edge enhances the dressy effect. The cuff resists wrinkling and maintains a clean, architectural line at the wrist.
